# Agiled

Agiled is an all-in-one business management platform designed to streamline operations such as CRM, project management, finance, and more.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/agiled/.

## Actions

- **Create Project**: Create a new project in agiled.
- **Create Task**: Create a new task in agiled.
- **Create Ticket**: Create a new support ticket in agiled.
- **Get Contacts** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all contacts.
- **Get Currencies** (read-only): List currencies.
- **Get Deals** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all deals.
- **Get Employees** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all employees.
- **Get Estimates** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all estimates.
- **Get Expenses** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all expenses.
- **Get Invoices** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all invoices from agiled.
- **Get Products** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all products.
- **Get Projects** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all projects.
- **Get Tickets** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all tickets.
- **Get Timesheets** (read-only): Retrieve timesheets for a project.
- **Get Users** (read-only): Retrieve a list of users from agiled.
- **GET_TASKS** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all tasks.
- **Create Expense**: Create a new expense in agiled.
- **Get Project Categories** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all project categories.
